figures.caption: Inhibitory effect of each treatment on Microsporum canis growth. Vertical bars represent standard errors of the mean value of three trials; columns with the same letter above show no significant difference between them at p < 0.05 according to Tukey's range test. Abbreviations: CE; cyclic lipopeptide extract (10 mg/mL), F; fengycin (0.5 mg/mL), I; iturin A (2 mg/mL), S; surfactin (1 mg/mL).
